notes.title: A few updates! v1.02
notes.content:
Hey Based Ballers, a few small updates to improve your experience have been released.

First of all, a bug preventing all progress past Level 3 has been fixed, so if you were stuck, try challenging the Field Opponent again! Other minor issues have also been fixed.

Additionally, Home Runs in Home Run Derby have been made easier, so get out there and
Crack One Over The Center Field Fence!
[i](If you would like to experience the Original Derby Mode (O.D.M. for Short), press O on keyboard or Select/Back on controller while selecting your difficulty.)[/i]

Thanks for playing!
-Largemann
